# CANDIDATE: VWAP_DEVIATION_MEAN_REVERSION_SHORT

**Filed:** 2026-07-09  
**Filer:** chef-nemotron (free-tier autonomous R&D)  
**Type:** new_trigger  
**Status:** DRAFT (NEEDS-RATIFICATION per Rule 9)

## Hypothesis

When price deviates significantly above VWAP early in the session (first 5-min bar after 09:30 ET) and exhibits weak buying pressure (small real body <30% of range, long upper wick >2× body), it tends to revert to VWAP as intraday liquidity absorbs the excess. This fade strategy targets short-term mean reversion in SPY 0DTE puts under moderate volatility (VIX 15-25) and tight opening ranges (<0.5% of SPY price), exploiting temporary order flow imbalances that fail to sustain.

## Mechanism

**Entry:** At the close of the first 5-min bar after 09:30 ET if:  
(1) close > VWAP,  
(2) (close - open) / (high - low) < 0.3 (body <30% of range),  
(3) upper wick > 2 × body.  
Enter short at that bar's close.  

**Exit:**  
- Primary stop: high of the entry bar (invalidates weak-buy signal).  
- Primary target: 1× risk (distance from entry to VWAP).  
- Optional second target: 2× risk if price closes below VWAP with strong bearish body (close < open and body >50% of range).  
- Time exit: 15:50 ET if neither stop nor target hit.  

**Regime filters:** Only active when VIX is between 15-25 AND day's opening range width (ORH-ORL) < 0.5% of SPY opening price.
